name: KBC Corporation, Ltd.
summary: KBC Corporation, Ltd. specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of carbon-based composite materials and associated products. Their product portfolio encompasses components for single-crystal pulling furnace hot zones, such as crucibles, reflectors, shields, heaters, rings, and electrodes. They also supply MOCVD disks and single-crystal hot zones tailored for the semiconductor industry, alongside rods and boats utilized in vacuum heat treatment processes. Furthermore, KBC produces washers and sealing rings for mechanical engineering uses, and mold sleeves and frames designed for high-temperature and high-pressure forming applications. Custom-made products are also a significant part of their offerings. These materials find utility across various sectors including high-temperature heat treatment, resistance to wear and corrosion, solar energy, and semiconductor manufacturing. Established in 2005, the company's main office is located in Yiyang, China.
